# The Auditable Truth API & MCP for Modern Fintechs
One stable endpoint. A native MCP server. Audit-grade FX proof your sales team — or your AI agents — deliver in under 30 seconds.

### Powered by iPayX AI Engine
iPayX AI Engine reads bank statements, detects FX spreads, and returns structured JSON output. Every audit response includes a confidence score and spread benchmark.
MCP Server — Model Context Protocol
Officially listed on the MCP Registry (v1.3.3)
## The world's first MCP-native FX audit engine
Plug iPayX directly into Claude Desktop, Cursor, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Perplexity, n8n. Your AI agents can audit an FX transfer, verify a rate, or generate a forensic report — without leaving their tool.

`full_forensic_report`
Full forensic report + Proof-Link (API key)
MCP Server URL
`https://mcp.ipayx.ai/mcp`

```
{
"mcpServers": {
"ipayx-fx-audit": {
"url": "https://mcp.ipayx.ai/mcp",

```

| Method | Endpoint | Description | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | /v1/audit | Returns structured FX audit analysis for one or more transactions, including per-partner score and thresholds applied. | Live |
| GET | /v1/score-config | List scoring profiles | Live |
| PUT | /v1/score-config | Upsert a profile | Live |
| DELETE | /v1/score-config | Remove a profile | Live |

title: iPayX MCP Server — Documentation
snippet:
Connect your AI agent to real-time FX audit verdicts.
## 1. Endpoints
- **Production MCP:** `https://hvujzsdwcoweirroubeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp-server`
- **Documentation:** `https://hvujzsdwcoweirroubeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp-server/docs`
## 2. Available Tools
### audit_fx_transaction
Free tier
Score any FX transaction 1-10 with a qualitative verdict. Spread % and mid-market rate are never returned in the public response.
Input
```
{
"amount": 10000,
"currency_from": "USD",
"currency_to": "EUR",
"bank_rate": 0.9123,
"date": "2026-05-13"
}
```
Output (opaque public response)
```
{
"score": 7,
"color": "yellow",
"verdict": "Fair FX pricing",
"currency_pair": "USD/EUR",
"amount": 10000,
"date": "2026-05-13",
"encouragement": null
}
```
**Rate limit:** 10 audits / day per API key (free).
### full_forensic_fx_report
Paid tier ($199)
Full forensic audit including spread breakdown, projected loss, and partner routing intelligence. Requires a paid Bearer token.
Input
```
{
"audit_id": "uuid",
"include_routing": true
}
```
Output (opaque public response)
```
{
"audit_id": "uuid",
"score": 4,
"color": "orange",
"verdict": "FX pricing above market expectations",
"spread_pct": 2.21,
"mid_market_rate": 0.9241,
"projected_annual_loss_usd": 184500,
"recommended_partner": "ebury"
}
```
**Rate limit:** Unlimited on paid tier; priority routing.

## 3. Authentication
- **Method:** HTTP Bearer token in `Authorization` header.
- **Format:** `ipx_live_xxxxx` (production) or `ipx_test_xxxxx` (sandbox).
- **How to get a key:** [Open your iPayX dashboard → API keys](/dashboard).
```
Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json, text/event-stream
```
## 4. Compatible MCP Clients
- Claude Desktop / Claude.ai
- ChatGPT (via OpenAI Apps SDK)
- Microsoft Azure Foundry Agents — [setup guide](/integrations/microsoft-foundry)
- Cursor / Continue / Cline
- Lovable Agent
